comments.author: Egw
comments.body: It should work like the other historical event races. Having said that, I reached reward no. 5 which according to jap wiki and past memories should be at race no. 29 but I certainly didn't do 29 races. I probably did around 10 I'd say. Maybe some recent update had mercy on us.

comments.author: Egw
comments.body: OK it took me something like 17 or 18 races total to get the Traveler's Treasure Box, with 7 of them giving emergency returns too. I was out of game during the more recent Cape Town race event so I don't know how it was then, but I do remember the Azores race of a few years ago and it was much more torturing than this one.

comments.author: Visitor
comments.body: What made the Azores race event so excruciating was the restriction that all participants had to sail in a Light-class ship. By comparison, the others are indeed much simpler, and far less torturous. South Africa's waters went lawless during the Cape Town race, but even that really wasn't so bad to deal with.

comments.author: Anne
comments.body: Question: Do you get a special reward or something for being in the top 10 of the ship race?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Very good question. Wish I had an equally good answer, but never having been among the top ten, I've no idea. Sorry.

Most likely outcome at the moment: "Second World Circumnavigation". Increased Influence/Investment Effect for English players in the E. Coast of Latin America, as well as Tax Reduction for all trade good types in that area.

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
The top 10 players of shipracers get an additional reward from port official, which will be given often around a week after the shiprace ends. The following one of the three he may give:
1) Famous Admiral's Staff
2) Heavily Armoured Sterncastle
3) 3x Silver Tarot

It DOESN'T matter which position you are for this, however I find they should improve the rewards for shipracers.. Although those tickets are pretty suficient. You get 12x Race Participation Memorial Ticket when you do it for the first time/breaking your own record and otherwise 6x Race Participation Memorial Ticket.

The main historical reward is already said.
Hope this makes everything clear :-)

Kind Regards,

Huseyin-Gazi

comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body:
Well, I started my run during the bonus hour tonight, and saw that special speed-boost NPC ship while at sea, just a bit northwest of Nantes. The ship was called Special Patroller, and when I clicked on it, I received a message:

Ship speed has increased due to patrolling activities by friendly forces. Your ship is now less likely to be attacked by pirates.

I'm guessing it meant NPC pirates only, but the effect lasted until the bonus hour ended. I'd say it gave me about a full extra knot of speed at least. Oh, and since I completed one of two runs during the bonus hour, when I went to the bank, I was already up to the third reward of Change Expedition Destination Tickets x3. Quite a good start.

wiki:
Event Type: Ship Race (all classes)
Route: London to Rio de Janeiro

Details: Talk to any port official/guide in London, click Race Information button, choose Join option (1,000 ducats to register) and set sail when you are ready. The timer begins at sea and ends when you speak to the Rio port official.

Each completed trip counts as progress for your nation in the historical event and can unlock rewards (sent to bank; use Receive Item button to retrieve them when ready). You do not have to be in the top 10 to receive the rewards listed below.

During the weekend, a unique NPC called Special Patroller (a single Large Frigate) appears in the Bay of Biscay for one hour (21:00 to 22:00) around 15985,2609 or northwest from Nantes. During this time, acclaim from the Historical Event will be doubled.

If you click on the Special Patroller after having registered and begun your race, your ship speed will increase and your ship will be less likely to be attacked by pirates (NPC only). If you have not registered to race, clicking on the NPC confers no benefits.

Rewards:

1 trip - Headache Medication x3
? trips - Silver Tarot x3
? trips - Change Expedition Destination Ticket x3
? trips - Shipwreck Map Piece x3
? trips - Improved Gallant Staysail
? trips - Wanderer of the Ages Hat + Pioneer of History Title (if not yet unlocked)
? trips - Traveler's Treasure Box
